title: COgnitive-somatoSensory-MOtor Training to Improve Arm and Hand Function After Stroke (iCOSMO)
official: Comparing the Effect of a Graded Repetitive Arm Supplementary Home-based Exercise Programme With COgnitive-somatoSensory-MOtor Training to Improve Arm and Hand Function After Stroke (iCOSMO)
summary: The iCOSMO study investigates the feasibility and beneficial effects of an intervention combining sensation, motor and cognition to improve arm and hand function after chronic stroke.

interventions.name: Home Graded Repetitive Arm Supplementary Program (GRASP)
integrated Somatosensory-MOtor training using a COgnitive approach(iCOSMO)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of stroke
* Must be more than 6 months post-stroke
* Must be above 18 years old
* Must have some motor and/or somatosensory deficits in the upper limbs

Exclusion Criteria:

* A prior history of central nervous system dysfunction other than stroke
* Upper limb deficits resulting from non-stroke pathology
* Inability to cooperate, follow instructions or provide consent
